sentences.en: Mr White punished the boy for cheating on the examination.
sentences.zh: 怀特先生因为考试作弊惩罚了那个男孩。

sentences.en: To my dismay, he was caught cheating in the examination.
sentences.zh: 令我失望的是，他在考试中被抓住作弊。

sentences.en: We all consider it wrong to cheat on the test.
sentences.zh: 我们都认为考试作弊是不对的。
